readme.title: Jaalee BLE Integration for Home Assistant

descriptions.en: Home Assistant custom integration for Jaalee Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) temperature and humidity sensors.
descriptions.ko: Jaalee 저전력 블루투스(BLE) 온습도 센서를 위한 Home Assistant HACS 커스텀 통합구성요소입니다.

categories_review.source: README Supported devices identifies the Jaalee JHT temperature/humidity/battery beacon; this measures temperature and humidity rather than providing a generic Bluetooth service.
